globalAdvice.dates: Dates are Sacred: Evaluators calculate months literally. '2018-2019' might be counted as 2 months. Ensure MM/YYYY format matches the Years Requirement.
globalAdvice.regional: Regional (10%): If no direct regional experience, look for experience in a similar context or a comparable program setting. Local language skills are a plus.
globalAdvice.bolding: Tip: Look for BOLD keywords in the Employment Record section.

roles.title: Project Manager

reqs.adeq: 8+ yrs exp, Systems Analysis, Contract Mgmt

guide.edu: Master’s in MIS, Business & IT, CS, or IT Mgmt. (Pass/Fail).
guide.exp: 8+ Years progressive experience. Dates must show full 8 years.

torData: Masters' degree in MIS, Business & IT, CS, or IT Management.
Project Management certification e.g. PMP, Prince2.
8+ years progressive exp: systems analysis, scoping, design, testing, Software PM.
Proven experience in business process modelling and contract management.

roles.title: Program Process Optimization Expert

guide.edu: Master’s in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field from a recognized university.
guide.cert: Professional certification in accounting, finance, or process improvement.
guide.exp: 7+ Years in public sector, nonprofit, or program delivery (not only private-sector finance).

torData: Master's in Accounting, Finance, Public Administration, Economics, or a related field from a recognized university.
Proven expertise in process modernization initiatives.
7+ years in program reform, business process design, or digital transformation.
Familiarity with international program standards and assessment frameworks.
Hands-on with process tools, workflow engines, and API-based solutions.

roles.title: Business Analyst

guide.edu: Bachelor’s or Master’s (Master’s scores higher in Gen Quals).
guide.cert: Professional Cert in Business Analysis (CBAP, PMI-PBA).
guide.exp: 5+ Years as BA in Public Sector or Financial Systems.

torData: Bachelor's or Master's in Business Mgmt, Project Mgmt, Finance, CS/IT.
Professional certification in Business Analysis (e.g. CBAP).
5+ years as BA, ideally in public sector or financial or program systems.
Preparing BRDs, test cases, and user manuals.
Participated in training and change management processes.

roles.title: Solutions Architect

guide.exp: 7+ Years IT total. 4+ Years specifically as Enterprise Architect/Tech Lead.

torData: Bachelor's or Master's in CS/IT or related field.
Training/Certification in Enterprise Architecture (e.g. TOGAF).
7+ years in IT field.
4+ years as Enterprise Architect designing/implementing software solutions.

roles.title: Technology Lead

guide.edu: Bachelor’s in IT, SE, or CS (Mandatory).
guide.cert: None specified, but leadership experience is key.
guide.exp: 6+ Years IT. 5+ Years developing Ent Software. 5+ Years LEADERSHIP (Must say 'Team Lead', 'Manager').

torData: Bachelor's in IT, Software Engineering, or CS.
6+ years in IT field.
5+ years developing enterprise software.
5+ years in a leadership role managing technical teams (Critical).
Experience with auto-scaling and high transaction throughput systems.

roles.title: Information Security Expert

guide.exp: 5+ Years IT Design/Security. 3+ Years Specific Security Assessment/Ops.

torData: Bachelor's in CS/IT or related field.
Professional certification in Cyber Security (CISSP, CISM).
5+ years in IT design, dev, security.
3+ years specific experience in security assessment planning, testing or operations.

roles.title: Data Engineer

guide.exp: 5+ Years Data Eng/BI. 3+ Years Dimensional Data Modeling (Must appear explicitly).

torData: Bachelor's in CS, IT, Software Engineering.
5+ years in Data Eng, BI & Software Dev.
3+ years specific experience with Dimensional data modeling.
Proven experience in analytical, visualization (PowerBI/Tableau), and data streaming tools.
